SELECT * FROM
OPENROWSET
(
    BULK 'revenue/revenue_star.csv',
    DATA_SOURCE = 'raw_ext_source',
    FORMAT = 'CSV',
    PARSER_VERSION = '2.0',
    HEADER_ROW = TRUE
) AS QUERY1;


SELECT * FROM
OPENROWSET
(
    BULK 'revenue/titanic.parquet',
    DATA_SOURCE = 'raw_ext_source',
    FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
) AS QUERY2;
